compatibility_matrix.functional_unit: 1 kg of food product consumed at the consumer (food workbook); 1 kg of agricultural product at farm gate (agriculture workbooks)
compatibility_matrix.system_boundary: Cradle-to-grave / field-to-plate across 6 stages (Agriculture, Transformation, Emballage, Transport, Supermarché et distribution, Consommation) for food products; cradle-to-farm-gate for agricultural products
compatibility_matrix.lcia_method: EF 3.1 adapted for SimaPro v1.00 (EF 3.1 normalization/weighting single score mPt + 16 midpoint indicators + 3 climate sub-indicators; long-term emissions included)
compatibility_matrix.geography: FR (France consumption mix for food products; France farm gate for agriculture)

compatibility_matrix.functional_unit: 1 kg of ripened cheese (FU = 1kg of cheese)
compatibility_matrix.system_boundary: Cradle-to-ripened-cheese factory/shared-cellar exit gate across 7 base stages (Milk production, Milk transport, Milk pumping, Milk storage, Milk processing, Cheese ripening, Equipment cleaning) plus Cheese transport in Alternative scenario; excludes packaging, retail and consumer stages
compatibility_matrix.lcia_method: EF 3.0 / ILCD-compatible 28-indicator midpoint suite (16 main categories + 3 climate sub-indicators + 9 toxicity/ecotoxicity chemical-group sub-indicators; no single score)
compatibility_matrix.geography: FR (44 French Protected Designation of Origin cheese supply chains; Ecoinvent 3 FR/RER/GLO & AGRIBALYSE 3.0 FR)
compatibility_matrix.reference_year: 2020-2022 (PDO specifications accessed 2020; workbooks modified 2022; AGRIBALYSE 3.0 milk)

compatibility_matrix.functional_unit: Process-specific quantitative reference flow (primarily 1 kg, 1000 kg, 1.10516007 kg, 13.5 kg, 1 Mg, 1 sh tn = 907.18474 kg, 1 t*km, 1 m3, 1 l, 1 MJ, or 1 kWh)
compatibility_matrix.system_boundary: Gate-to-gate unit processes (1,408 UNIT_PROCESS) and cradle-to-gate aggregated processes (26 LCI_RESULT)
compatibility_matrix.lcia_method: None bundled in export (0 lcia_methods in JSON-LD; requires external TRACI/IPCC/EF characterization factors)
compatibility_matrix.geography: US / Northern America primary (730 US, 182 Northern America, 96 Global, 391 unspecified/regional variants)

compatibility_matrix.functional_unit: 1 kg of virgin plastic resin (PET, HDPE, LDPE, PP, PVC) or 1 kg of olefin monomer (ethylene, propylene); also 1 kWh electricity and 1 MJ natural gas in Figure 18
compatibility_matrix.system_boundary: Cradle-to-gate virgin resin / monomer production (raw material extraction through monomer and polymerization at plant gate; excludes package conversion, transport to dairy, filling and end-of-life)
compatibility_matrix.lcia_method: GREET 2022 100-year GHG Carbon Intensity (kg CO2e / kg, covering CO2, CH4, N2O)
compatibility_matrix.geography: USA, Western Europe, MENA (Middle East and North Africa), China, and 4-region Cross-regional average
compatibility_matrix.reference_year: 2024 report (GREET 2022 model; 2020 IEA electricity/NG data; 2010-2016 baseline technology shares with 2019-2022 sensitivity)

compatibility_matrix.functional_unit: Per unit of processed milk or product: L/L processed milk, kWh/L processed milk, Liters/L processed milk, kg/1000 l (solid waste), L/kg ice cream, KWh/kg ice cream; mg/l, pH, degC, MPN/100 ml for effluent guidelines
compatibility_matrix.system_boundary: Gate-to-gate dairy processing facility operations (milk reception, processing, CIP cleaning, utilities, wastewater discharge and solid waste; excludes raw milk farming and upstream packaging manufacture)
compatibility_matrix.lcia_method: Operational intensity benchmarks and regulatory/guideline effluent concentration limits (not LCIA)
compatibility_matrix.geography: International guideline; Table 2-3 benchmarks from European, Swedish, Danish, Finnish and Norwegian dairies
compatibility_matrix.reference_year: 2007 publication (underlying plant survey benchmarks from 2001-2002 / EC 2006 BREF)

integration_decisions.combination: AGRIBALYSE (cradle-to-grave, incl. baseline packaging) x packaging factor catalogue

integration_decisions.residual_risk: Other stages (transport, distribution) still embed AGRIBALYSE packaging assumptions

integration_decisions.combination: NIST/ANL resin GWP (GREET 2022) x USLCI (IPCC AR6 characterised here) x proxies
integration_decisions.why: No single source covers all packaging materials, conversion, transport and EoL
integration_decisions.safeguard: Each factor carries source_dataset_id, source_type, lcia_method, system_boundary
